empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is reusable review guidance — text an agent gets appended to its prompt. Write one and link it to an agent.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

editor.enabledHint: A disabled skill reaches no agent’s prompt, however it is linked.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: The skill’s interface — write it as a directive, saying when the skill applies.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: When the diff adds a .then() chain, require async/await instead.
editor.bodyHint: Appended to the prompt of every agent that links this skill, verbatim.
editor.usedBy: used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}
editor.previewNotice: This is the text the agent receives. It becomes instructions in the prompt — not data.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this skill?
deleteConfirm.body: Deleting “{name}” removes it and its version history. This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.usedByWarning: It is linked to {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}, which will lose it:

new.title: Create skill

versions.hint: A content edit appends a version. Toggling Enabled does not.
